overview: A compositional layout wrapper that arranges one or more buttons with consistent spacing and responsive behavior. Buttons are passed as children and rendered inside an unstyled list. An optional `label` can be displayed above the group. The `direction` prop controls horizontal or vertical layout; horizontal groups automatically switch to a vertical column on viewports narrower than 640 px.

whenToUse: When two or more related actions need to be presented together with uniform spacing
When a set of buttons must reflow to a vertical stack on small screens
do: Use `direction="vertical"` when actions are stacked in a side panel or a form footer with limited width
Provide a `label` when the group of actions benefits from a short heading for context
Keep the number of buttons in a group small - typically two to four actions
dont: Mix buttons of very different sizes inside the same group
